Welcome to KSPS PBS, your source for captivating on-air, online, and multimedia programs that entertain, engage, and educate. Join us as we explore the fascinating worlds of science, history, and nature, offering diverse perspectives and trusted insights to enrich the communities we serve.

With a reach of two million households across the Inland Northwest and Canada, KSPS PBS invites you to take a front row seat to world-class performances and immerse yourself in thought-provoking content. We proudly serve Spokane, eastern Washington, northern Idaho, western Montana, southeastern British Columbia, and most of Alberta, including Calgary and Edmonton.

Subscribe now to join our vibrant community and embark on a journey of knowledge, inspiration, and entertainment. Let's expand horizons and explore the possibilities of the human experience.
